verdict.rationale: Trello's own docs say it tracks the progress of tasks in a visual layout. A community user describes an Idea => Doing => Done flow, which covers the status part of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents priority fields, an owning-team attribute, or initiative-level tracking. missing for 10: documented priority field, owning-team assignment, initiative or portfolio-level tracking, custom fields, independent hands-on corroboration for PM initiative tracking.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Track progress of tasks in one convenient place with a visual layout that adds 'ta-da' to your to-do's.
Idea board => Doing board => Done board.
